data.subtitle: Both sit in the model menu next to the send button.

composer.text: Summarise this report in five bullet points for my manager.

steps: Click the **model name** next to the send button
Pick a model, or **More models** for the rest
Click **Effort**: Low, Medium, High, Extra high or Max
data.note: The recommended effort is marked Default. Drawn from the official help pages; your screen may look a little different.
